description: Large Raised Reservoir (Registered information) is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Natural Resources Wales. This dataset contains details of Large Raised Reservoirs. Natural Resources Wales (NRW) collects and maintains data on reservoirs designed or capable of holding more than 10,000 cubic metres of water above the natural level of any part of the land adjoining them defined as 'large raised reservoirs' under the Reservoirs Act 1975. Coverage: Natural Resources Wales. The portal files it under the publisher Natural Resources Wales. Its tags are Ecosystem (SMNR), Flooding (SMNR), Freshwater and Wetlands (SMNR), Hydrological Processes (SMNR), Natural Resources (Incl. Features and Processes) (. The portal shows 2026-09-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
